text:
Sana M: Heads-up: new hire Aiko S arrives Mon. She's on a work-visa and only has a consular stamped photocopy arriving by courier. Need to confirm I-9 acceptance and badge plan.
People Ops (Pia): We can accept consular-stamped photocopy + gov renewal receipt as temporary under a 3-business-day verification exception. Need signed exception form and vendor note.
Visa Admin (Leo): courier says original docs will arrive Tue afternoon. I'll attach the vendor tracking once booked. For now upload the apostille scan to the secure intake link.
Sana M: Aiko can present boarding pass + consular scan at reception on Day 1. Can we issue a temporary badge with restricted access?
Facilities: Yes. We issue a time-limited visitor-style badge for up to 72 hours. Access restricted to floors 3 and 4 and conference rooms. Exchange for permanent badge upon doc verification.
IT Ops: We'll stage a laptop (asset LTP-3512) and create a time-limited AD account aiko.s.temp (expires in 5 days). MFA enrollment blocked until final verification.
courier-bot: Courier options: same-day pickup not available. Next-morning delivery to SF office ETA Tue 11:45. Tracking CR-91234.
People Ops (Pia): Action list: 1) Sana to confirm Aiko uploads apostille PDF; 2) Leo to forward courier tracking once scheduled; 3) Facilities to reserve temp badge; 4) IT Ops to stage LTP-3512 and temp account; 5) Pia to open exception case HR-4688 and DM signed form to Aiko.
Sana M: Uploaded apostille at 20:12. I'll confirm Aiko knows to bring boarding pass + renewal receipt.
People Ops (Pia): Will send benefits enrollment note: we run a 10:30 walkthrough Mon. Aiko can enroll Day 1. Reminder: bring dependent SSNs if needed.
Sana M: Thanks everyone, closing — exception logged and laptop/badge staged. Will update when courier tracking arrives.
Visa Admin (Leo): Courier booked: CR-91234 scheduled. Will post update when it scans into the building.
